resolution.rationale: Binding clean audit. The cited official and exact-address ordering evidence confirms the operating Vienna restaurant at 442 Maple Ave E; the five current food/nonalcoholic surfaces and one alcohol-only out-of-scope surface resolve to a fully covered 53-product catalog. All four required official-matrix searches are documented and credible. No allergen absence or product-level cross-contact claim is inferred from empty arrays, the generic best-attempt accommodation statement, or unavailable evidence, and every retained positive is tied to restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked ingredient evidence.
